jobId.description: Terminal persistent job identifier whose explicit cleanup contract should run.

jobAccessToken.description: Capability token returned when the persistent job started.

expectedProjectPath.description: Expected Unity project root; rejects cross-project mutation.

expectedProjectName.description: Optional project name used as an additional target-binding check.

jobId.description: Opaque identifier of the persistent Job.

jobAccessToken.description: Capability token used to access the Job after its originating agent disconnects.

jobType.description: Durable Job owner type used to resume the correct workflow.

tags.description: Presence-only Job capabilities and positive lifecycle facts.

cleanupStatus.description: Current lifecycle state of the Job's explicit cleanup workflow.

cleanupToken.description: Opaque tool-defined token consumed by the explicit cleanup contract.

progress.description: Normalized Job progress from zero through one.

statusMessage.description: Current human-readable progress or terminal-status summary.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller key bound to the exact operation arguments for safe reuse.

startedAt.description: UTC timestamp when execution first crossed the Job boundary.

completedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Job reached a terminal state.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the latest persisted Job mutation.

sideEffects.description: Exact side-effect categories declared by the originating operation.

assetPath.description: Texture, model, or audio asset path below Assets/.

description: Validate and update semantic TextureImporter, ModelImporter, or AudioImporter settings, optional platform overrides, and reimport behavior.

assetPath.description: Texture, model, or audio asset path below Assets/.

settings.description: Semantic importer fields. Unsupported keys are rejected with the allowed field list.

platform.description: Optional Unity platform override name such as Standalone, Android, or iPhone.

platformSettings.description: Optional semantic TextureImporter or AudioImporter override settings for platform.

reimport.description: Save and reimport the asset after updating settings. Defaults to true.

dryRun.description: Validate and return before/requested settings without modifying the importer.

expectedProjectPath.description: Expected Unity project root; rejects cross-project mutation.

expectedProjectName.description: Optional project name used as an additional target-binding check.

description: List loaded scenes, open a scene additively or singly, close a loaded scene with an explicit dirty-scene policy, or set the active scene.

action.description: Workspace action: list, open, close, or set-active. Defaults to list.

path.description: Scene asset path for open, close, or set-active.

name.description: Loaded scene name for close or set-active when path is omitted.

saveModified.description: For single open, save every dirty loaded scene before replacement.

discardModified.description: For single open, explicitly allow replacement of dirty loaded scenes without saving.

save.description: For close, save a dirty scene before closing.

discardChanges.description: For close, explicitly discard dirty scene changes.

removeScene.description: For close, remove the scene from the workspace. Defaults to true.

expectedProjectPath.description: Expected Unity project root; rejects cross-project mutation.

expectedProjectName.description: Optional project name used as an additional target-binding check.

description: Read a Material's shader, typed shader properties, textures, keywords, render queue, and instancing settings through Unity's public Material API.

propertyNames.description: Optional shader property names. Omit to page through declared shader properties.

limit.description: Maximum shader properties returned. Defaults to 100; capped at 500.
limit.x-unityMcpDefaultSource: Preferences/Unity MCP > Tool Responses > Default Result Limit (when override is enabled)

description: Transactionally set typed Material shader properties, texture references and transforms, keywords, render queue, and instancing settings.

properties.description: Shader property values keyed by declared shader property name. Texture values accept assetPath plus optional scale and offset.

keywords.description: Keyword changes with enable and disable string arrays.

dryRun.description: Validate and return requested changes without modifying the Material.
